name: Real Dimez
summary: A notorious Vice City rap duo built on street shakedowns, viral social media hooks, and chasing one shot at global superstardom.
description: Real Dimez reflects modern Leonida youth and influencer culture, combining high-octane hip-hop tracks with live-streamed street antics. Associated with Dre'Quan Priest's music production stable, their escalating rivalries and viral clout-chasing frequently erupt into armed shootouts across Vice City corridors.

seo.title: Real Dimez: Vice City Rap Duo & Street Contacts
seo.description: Profile of the Real Dimez duo in GTA VI. Music tracks, social media influence, Dre'Quan Priest connections, and missions.
